integrations.label: Connects to the tools you already use
integrations.note: Solid: live today. Dashed: next on the roadmap.

leak.title: Your sales say one number. Your bank says another.
leak.lead: The gap is refused orders, cash stuck with couriers and costs scattered across five tools. Most dashboards report it after it happens. Mizan stops it before the parcel leaves.

door.title: Refused at the door
door.body: Unconfirmed COD orders ship, get refused, and you pay shipping both ways.

cash.title: Cash stuck with couriers
cash.body: Collected money sits with couriers for weeks, and short payments go unnoticed.

profit.title: Profit nobody can see
profit.body: Fees, returns, ads and product costs live in different tools, so no one knows what an order really earned.

how.title: From checkout to cash, on autopilot.

order.title: Order arrives
order.body: From Shopify, your POS or social. Every order gets its payment method and a risk score.

confirm.title: Confirmed on WhatsApp
confirm.body: Customers confirm in one tap, in Egyptian Arabic. Risky orders get a deposit link first.

ship.title: Shipped right
ship.body: Mizan books the courier and tells them to collect only the balance still owed.

reconcile.title: Reconciled to the pound
reconcile.body: Settlements are matched order by order, and you see the real profit of each one.

payments.title: Not just COD. Every way your customers pay.
payments.lead: Each order carries its payment method and status, so shipping, collection and refunds always match what was actually paid.

cod.title: Cash on delivery
cod.body: Confirmed before it ships. The courier collects the exact amount due.

card.title: Cards
card.body: Paid orders ship straight away. Refunds are tracked to the order.

wallet.title: Mobile wallets
wallet.body: Wallet payments are matched to the order automatically.

deposit.title: Deposit + COD
deposit.body: Risky orders pay a deposit; the courier collects only the rest.

bnpl.title: Buy now, pay later
bnpl.body: Instalment providers settle to you; Mizan tracks the fee.

bank.title: Bank transfer
bank.body: Held until the money arrives, then shipped automatically.

payments.rule: Unpaid or unknown payments never ship.
payments.ruleSub: It’s a rule in the engine, not a setting someone can forget.

automations.title: When this happens, do that. Across every module.
automations.lead: Start from ready recipes or build your own. Every automation is logged, safe to repeat and easy to switch off.

ship.title: Ship when the deposit is paid

profit.title: The real profit of every order.
profit.body: After shipping, gateway fees, returns, ads and product cost. Per order, product, channel and day.

warehouse.title: Warehouse and ops app
warehouse.body: Pick, pack and receive with a scanner app that keeps working offline.

inbox.title: Customer inbox
inbox.body: WhatsApp and calls in one shared queue, linked to the order.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.body: Courier and gateway settlements matched order by order, with claims for short payments.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.body: Sell in store with the same stock, customers and reports.

ai.title: AI analyst
ai.body: Ask in Arabic or English: why did profit drop last week?

returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.body: Returns go back to stock, and refunds go back the way the customer paid.

purchasing.title: Purchasing and suppliers
purchasing.body: Purchase orders, goods received and the true cost of every product.

arabic.title: Built in Arabic, not translated into it.
arabic.lead: Right to left from the first line of code, Egyptian Arabic in every customer message, and Gulf dialects for the GCC.
arabic.screens: Every screen in Arabic and English, web and mobile
arabic.dialect: Customer messages in the dialect your customers speak
arabic.numbers: Numbers, phones and order IDs that never break in RTL

tools.title: One system instead of five.
tools.lead: Stop copying orders between apps. Mizan replaces the patchwork and keeps every number in one place.

pricing.title: Priced by orders, never by percentage.
pricing.lead: Mizan never takes a cut of your sales. Your gateways and their fees stay yours. Annual billing gets 2 months free.
pricing.note: Prices exclude VAT. Messaging is billed at cost. Above your plan limit, a small per-order fee applies; no forced upgrade.

cod.q: Is Mizan only for cash on delivery?
cod.a: No. Mizan handles COD, cards, wallets, deposits, buy now pay later and bank transfers. Every order carries its payment method and status, and the courier collects only what’s still owed.

store.q: Do I need to change my store?
store.a: No. Connect Shopify in a few clicks and keep your storefront. Mizan reads your orders and writes back fulfilments and statuses.

couriers.a: Bosta is live today. More Egyptian and Gulf couriers are on the roadmap. Tell us which one you use and we’ll prioritise it.

cut.q: Does Mizan take a percentage of my sales?
cut.a: No. You pay a monthly plan based on your order volume. Payment gateways and their fees stay between you and them.

data.a: Customer data is encrypted, every access is logged, and Mizan is built to follow Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law and Saudi Arabia’s PDPL.

team.q: Can my team work in Arabic?
team.a: Yes. Every screen works in Arabic and English, right to left, on the web and in the ops app.
